# Public reference input

Original: https://github.com/ngspice/ngspice/blob/032b1c32c4dbad45ff132bcfac1dbecadbd8abb0/examples/measure/rc-meas-ac.sp
Retrieved 2026-09-21. Upstream license statement is retained verbatim in COPYING. This is a pinned historical official example, not a claim that the mirror's latest software release was tested.

`rc-meas-ac.sp` is unmodified. SHA-256: 896eb7c9cf78f0a3b5635842ac9e4b42312f9928e0eb4d9a60a49f00e4b8068c.

`analytic-reference.csv` is generated by our `scripts/reference_rc.py`: two-node complex nodal analysis cross-checked against an independently expressed closed-form transfer function, 41 frequencies / 82 metrics. It is **analytic reference data, not ngspice/Spectre output**. No PDK, private circuit, license file or company data is included.
